metric_scope.kernel: All emitted functions excluding outside startup/teardown.
metric_scope.whole_program_peak: Counter-reported peak managed live bytes, including startup; not RSS or C allocator scratch.
metric_scope.traffic: alloc_bytes and realloc_added_bytes are separate cumulative amounts; neither is peak memory.
metric_scope.rc: Core sites and runtime RC hooks remain separate because they can overlap.
metric_scope.copies: Hooked copies only; known text/buffer snapshot and runtime scratch blindspots remain.
